thread:
emily: opened a small docs PR to add an OCI mirror + cert distribution checklist for private/onprem installs. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1210. quick review please.

juan: can you keep examples short? customers just want copy/paste commands.

emily: yes. plan: (1) skopeo sync one-liner, (2) host CA install for Debian/RHEL, (3) ansible snippet to distribute certs + restart CRI, (4) imagePullSecrets example, (5) quick verify commands.

ravi: add a CRI-O note: `sudo update-ca-trust extract && sudo systemctl restart crio`. and for containerd: `sudo update-ca-certificates && sudo systemctl restart containerd`.

emily: added. ansible snippet is two tasks: copy `mirror-ca.pem` to `/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/` and run `update-ca-certificates` then restart CRI. kept it minimal.

juan: include `kubectl auth can-i` check for kms SA and a `kubectl describe pod` troubleshooting tip.

docs-bot: reminder: run `make docs-lint`, update docs/TOC.md if adding a subsection, and add a one-line CHANGELOG entry under "docs".

marta-cs: thanks — i'll paste the short checklist into the onboarding notes after merge. please backport to release/1.2.x after CI passes.

emily: will backport once merged. merging after green.
